bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
current="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
if test "$current" != "63c9f3fc97fabbdca3667dc04d1c4499e0d715e5"; then echo "TUMBLR_CHECKOUT_HEAD_DIFFERS"; exit 41; fi
if test -n "$(git status --porcelain)"; then echo "TUMBLR_CHECKOUT_DIRTY"; exit 42; fi
python3 -B -c 'import json; from scripts.tumblr_release import request; status,body=request(8081,"/healthz"); assert status==200, "TUMBLR_LIVE_HEALTH_FAILED"; commit=json.loads(body).get("commit"); assert commit=="63c9f3fc97fabbdca3667dc04d1c4499e0d715e5", "TUMBLR_LIVE_SHA_DIFFERS"; print("TUMBLR_LIVE_REVISION=PASS")'
PYTHONPATH=. python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_integration.py
PYTHONPATH=. python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_core.py
PYTHONPATH=. python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_analytics_runtime.py
echo TUMBLR_GSERVER_INDEPENDENT=PASS
